answer: Cross-network anchoring blocks Sybils: an identity counts only if the same key signs the epoch nonce on two ledgers with pre-epoch histories, like quartz in separate rock. A gale of fresh accounts cannot fabricate years of outside history, and auditors wander across both ledgers checking them. If a proof fails, enforcement is automatic: its 25.000 POA bond is seized, half burned, half to the challenger, and it is banned 8 epochs. Creating 1.000 fakes costs 25.000 x 1.000 = 25.000.000 POA, versus 25.000 once honest. Limitation: honest newcomers without long outside histories face a cold start.
